_comment: Boundary port policy (SD-WAN / firewall allow-list) used to attribute a BLOCKED on a policy-DENIED port to SEGMENTATION rather than the IPS/WAF. Copy to 'port_policy.json' (git-ignored) to override the built-in default. 'allow' = permitted service ports (attack reaches the boundary -> the IPS/WAF is the control under test). 'deny' = ports the policy blocks (a BLOCKED there is expected segmentation, not an IPS win). Anything in neither list is treated as default-deny. Env var $HARNESS_PORT_POLICY may point at an alternate path. The built-in default below is 'Polisi Standard Security v1.3'.
name: Polisi Standard Security v1.3
